channel.title: Vox Updates
channel.description: Updates for Vox — push-to-talk dictation for macOS.

item.title: Vox 0.7.6
item.description:
• Fix: Screen Sharing/VNC insertion now uses Unicode text key events instead of Shift-modified physical key events. This preserves capitalization when the VNC client drops synthetic Shift modifiers.
  • Diagnostics: Vox still leaves the transcript on the local clipboard, so if remote text insertion behaves oddly you can paste locally to confirm the processed transcript text.

item.title: Vox 0.7.5
item.description:
• Fix: Screen Sharing/VNC no longer depends on remote clipboard paste. Vox now types dictation and Paste Last Transcription directly into the VNC session as physical key events, preserving shifted characters where VNC accepts them.
  • Fix: RustDesk keeps its unmodified physical-typing path because that client drops synthetic modifier keys; Screen Sharing/VNC gets a separate shifted-key path for better fidelity.

item.title: Vox 0.7.4
item.description:
• Fix: Screen Sharing/VNC paste now waits briefly for remote clipboard synchronization, then invokes the front app's local Edit → Paste menu before falling back to the key event path. This avoids the remote Mac pasting its previous clipboard value while the new Vox transcript is still propagating.
  • Diagnostics: Remote paste now logs the detected frontmost app bundle/name and selected paste target to ~/Library/Logs/vox.log, making VNC/RustDesk detection easier to verify.

item.title: Vox 0.7.3
item.description:
• Fix: Screen Sharing/VNC paste no longer restores the previous clipboard before the remote side has consumed the transcript. VNC targets now keep the dictated text on the local clipboard to avoid pasting stale manual clipboard contents.
  • Feature: Settings → Smart cleanup now includes personal cleanup instructions stored at ~/Library/Application Support/Vox/cleanup-profile.md, so you can ask the cleanup model to preserve your voice and avoid over-polishing.
  • Fix: Smart cleanup now receives active prose dictionary entries and Vox reapplies the dictionary after cleanup, preventing terms like Lenard from drifting back to common spellings. Dictionary matching also handles possessives such as Leonard's → Lenard's.

item.title: Vox 0.7.2
item.description:
• Fix: dictation into remote desktop sessions now has app-specific paste handling. Screen Sharing/VNC uses a System Events paste fallback because the standard synthesized ⌘V path can lose modifiers inside the remote session.
  • Fix: RustDesk now avoids paste shortcuts entirely and types the transcript as plain physical keypresses. RustDesk drops synthetic modifier keys, which caused earlier attempts to insert only a lowercase v or no text. This fallback may lowercase letters and approximate shifted punctuation, but it should deliver text to the remote cursor.
  • Docs: README and in-app help now document remote desktop behavior and the current default to keep the transcript on the clipboard after paste.

item.title: Vox 0.7.1
item.description:
• Feature: meeting capture now records VoIP-app audio (Phone.app, FaceTime, Continuity calls). These route through privileged CoreAudio paths that the existing display tap couldn't see; a new process tap on macOS 14.4+ mixes callservicesd / avconferenced / imagent / identityservicesd into an AAC m4a alongside mic + system streams.
  • Feature: Deepgram diarization is now per-source instead of one mixed file. Mic / phone / system each get their own request and speaker IDs are namespaced per source (0 system / +100 phone / nil for mic). Fixes cases where distinct voices on a mixed file collapsed to one Speaker ID. "You" reserves green so it never matches a remote speaker color.
  • Fix: dictation transcript now stays on the clipboard by default. The prior ~1.5s restore was racing web text inputs (Comet, Perplexity sidebar, Slack web) that read the pasteboard asynchronously after ⌘V, so they pulled the pre-paste contents instead of the transcript. Opt out in Settings if you preferred the old behavior.
  • Fix: meeting HUD timer freezes the moment you click Stop (prefers session.endedAt over now) instead of running through the full transcribe phase.
  • Fix: the meeting panel now auto-shows for a new Teams/Zoom meeting even while a previous session is still chunking / transcribing in the background. Gate flipped from !isActive to !isRecording.
  • Improvement: Settings provider picker shows "≈ $X.XX / hour of audio" for both meeting providers (Deepgram $0.258, OpenAI $0.36), parallel to the dictation model rate caption.
  • Improvement: Transcripts, Main, and Settings windows now follow you across Spaces and full-screen apps (collectionBehavior = [.canJoinAllSpaces, .fullScreenAuxiliary]) like the meeting HUD already did.

item.title: Vox 0.7.0
item.description:
• Feature: meeting transcription gains a Deepgram Nova-3 backend with proper diarization. Mic + system audio are mixed into a single composition and sent in one batch request, so speakers are tagged Speaker 0 / 1 / 2 … across the whole meeting instead of just Local vs Remote. Settings → Meeting picks the provider; default is Deepgram if a key is configured (Settings → Deepgram API key), else OpenAI Whisper as before.
  • Feature: per-meeting "Re-transcribe (Deepgram)" button in the transcript browser. Reruns an existing meeting through Deepgram using the retained audio on disk, replacing segments + summary in place. Useful for rescuing meetings you transcribed before this release.
  • Improvement: summary prompt rewritten to refuse name-guessing. The summarizer no longer attributes action items to a participant unless that participant self-identifies in the transcript. Speaker IDs (Speaker N) are used as opaque labels.
  • Improvement: meeting control panel is now sticky across all virtual desktops and full-screen apps (canJoinAllSpaces + fullScreenAuxiliary), so the Stop button stays reachable when you switch Spaces mid-call.
  • Improvement: meeting transcript window now shows speaker labels per segment (color-cycled by speaker ID), exposes a visible scrollbar, and caps the summary disclosure at 180 pt so the transcript below stays readable. Plain-text and timestamped exports include the speaker labels.

item.title: Vox 0.6.8
item.description: • Fix: dictation no longer fails with "Transport error: The request timed out" on stale-keepalive timeouts. Symptom: an occasional single-sentence dictation would hang ~60s and surface a timeout error even on a healthy network. Cause: URLSession.shared reuses a TCP keepalive socket; if the socket dies idle, the next send hangs the full timeout, and the existing 2-attempt retry reused the same dead pool. Vox now uses a 15s per-attempt timeout (down from 30s), retries 3 times instead of 2, and retries on a fresh ephemeral URLSession so a dead keepalive can't time us out twice in a row.

item.title: Vox 0.6.7
item.description: • Fix: meeting mic now self-recovers when its OS-level audio input stalls. macOS sometimes lets the input HAL go silent mid-session (Teams renegotiating sample rate, USB power management, exclusive-access contention) — AVAudioRecorder didn't notice and kept encoding zero PCM samples for the rest of the meeting, losing the user's voice. A new watchdog polls peak power every second; after 30 s of consecutive floor-level silence it tears down the recorder and starts a fresh one. At stop the parts are concatenated into a single m4a so the transcription pipeline is unchanged. Reported in 0.6.5/0.6.6 when a 35-min meeting captured only the first 9 min of local mic.

item.title: Vox 0.6.6
item.description:
• Fix: a failed meeting recorder start (TCC drop, device busy) used to leave the session pinned at recording on disk and in memory, so subsequent Record clicks bounced with "already active" until the app was relaunched. start() now resets state on failure and surfaces the error.
  • Fix: a failed recorder stop similarly stranded sessions at chunking. stop() now clears state on failure and bails cleanly.
  • Fix: the floating Meeting panel's Record button now runs the same preflight gate as the menu-bar entry — Meeting Mode disabled, no consent acknowledgement, or no API key now produces a visible error instead of starting a half-configured session.
  • Fix: silent meeting audio is no longer reported as audible. Pre-fix, a fully silent file longer than 100ms still passed the SilenceTrim gate and was sent to Whisper, defeating the hallucination filter.
  • Fix: tap-to-toggle works on Fn and single-modifier hotkeys. The dispatcher routed flagsChanged events for those keys but the tap handler only accepted keyDown — selecting tap mode on the default Fn binding silently disabled recording.
  • Fix: first-buffer peak probe in AudioRecorder no longer traps on a clipped Int16.min sample. abs(-32768) overflows Int16 — now widens to Int before negating.

item.title: Vox 0.6.5
item.description:
• Auto-show meeting panel when a call starts (Settings → Meeting; default off). Vox polls window titles every few seconds and pops the floating Meeting panel as soon as it sees Teams (channel meetings, 1:1, compact view), Zoom, Webex, Slack huddle, Discord voice/video, Skype, Google Meet, or web Zoom/Webex. Recording is never auto-started — you still click Record on the panel.
  • Meeting summary (Settings → Meeting; default on). After transcription completes, segments are sent to gpt-4o-mini and a markdown summary (Summary / Key decisions / Action items) is rendered as a disclosure at the top of the transcript browser. Cost ~$0.0005 per meeting. Skipped silently if API key missing.

item.title: Vox 0.6.4
item.description: • Verbatim / literal prefix: say "verbatim" or "literal" as the first word of a prose dictation and Vox skips both trigger expansion and the LLM cleanup pass. The prefix is stripped; the rest is pasted as Whisper transcribed it. In-band escape hatch so a single dictation can stay literal without toggling Smart Cleanup off globally. Mid-sentence "verbatim" / "literal" is left intact.

item.title: Vox 0.6.3
item.description: • Fix: dictation no longer pastes the prior clipboard contents instead of the transcript. The clipboard restore was racing the target app's paste handler in slower apps (Slack, Electron, browser inputs) — by the time the app actually executed ⌘V, Vox had already restored the prior clipboard. Restore is now delayed to 1.5s and skipped if anything else has written to the clipboard in the meantime.

item.title: Vox 0.6.2
item.description:
• Paste Last Transcription: new entry in the menu-bar dropdown re-pastes the most recent dictation into the focused app. Works regardless of whether the dictation paste landed in the right window the first time.
  • Opt-in paste-last hotkey: Settings → Hotkeys → "Paste last transcription". Disabled by default — pick any combo to enable. Independent of the dictation hotkey.
  • Outbound paste shortcut hardcoded to ⌘V: the previous "Paste keystroke (sent to focused app)" setting was a footgun — remapping it broke paste in apps that only honor ⌘V. Removed from Settings.
  • Fix: clipboard now restores correctly after dictation when "Keep transcription on clipboard" is off. Prior code skipped the restore when the prior clipboard held an image or was empty, leaving the transcript stuck on the clipboard.

item.title: Vox 0.6.1
item.description: • Fix: dictation no longer deadlocks AVAudioEngine after a meeting + several recordings. The 0.6.0 build recreated the engine on every start(); that triggered an internal IOUnitDispose vs IOUnitConfigurationChanged livelock under audio-config flux. Engine is now reused with an explicit stop() + reset() at the start of each recording.

item.title: Vox 0.6.0
item.description:
• Dictation streamed to disk: every recording is written to ~/Library/Application Support/Vox/Recordings/ as it captures, so silence-gated, hallucination-guarded, or crashed dictations leave a recoverable WAV. Crash-recovery patches half-finished WAV headers on launch.
  • Audio retention sweep: Settings → Recordings storage. Default 1 month; transcripts are kept indefinitely. Reveal-in-Finder buttons + live disk usage.
  • Tiered silence gate: long quiet recordings now transcribe instead of being dropped. Short+quiet still gated to suppress Whisper hallucinations.
  • Meeting cascade fix: kills the "I don't know." × N hallucination Whisper produced when the mic was muted in Zoom. Drops runs of 4+ identical short segments.
  • Whisper filler filter: drops single-segment hallucinations like "you", "thanks for watching", "subscribe", "bye" that Whisper inserts on silent leading audio.
  • Manual meeting Record/Stop panel: meeting hotkey now toggles the floating panel. Click Record to start, Stop to end. Closing the panel hides the UI but doesn't stop the recording. Stop auto-opens the transcript browser.
  • Status-bar menu refresh: Meeting / Dictionary / Settings entries deep-link the matching tab in the main window. SF Symbol icons on every row.
  • Audio engine reset per recording: dictation no longer captures silent buffers after a meeting session releases the mic.

Reminder: macOS TCC re-prompts for Microphone / Input Monitoring / Accessibility on each ad-hoc-signed release. Re-grant in System Settings → Privacy & Security after updating.

item.title: Vox 0.5.1
item.description:
• New icon: chrome V on a squircle. Replaces the previous bubble glyph.
  • Per-mode menu bar icon: cyan/teal in prose mode, amber/gold in command/terminal mode. Updates immediately when you switch frontmost app.
  • Recording / transcribing still signaled by a small colored dot badge over the V (red / orange).
  • Fix: mode toggle hotkey now flips directly between prose and command on a single press (skips .auto so the change is always visible).

item.title: Vox 0.5.0
item.description:
• Main window: sidebar nav (Home / Dictionary / Meeting / Settings / Help). Auto-opens on launch, hides on close. Click menu-bar icon to reopen.
  • Home: stat cards plus recent dictations and recent meetings.
  • Dictation history: every dictation is saved to disk. Configurable retention (forever / 1y / 90d / 30d) in Settings.
  • Fix: Whisper hallucination filter drops the "yeah, yeah, yeah, ..." 30-second repetitions on quiet mic input.
  • Fix: Keychain access cached in process memory so dictations no longer re-prompt for ACL approval each time.
  • Fix: meeting Delete now correctly redraws (was a UI-refresh bug, not data loss).

item.title: Vox 0.4.0
item.description:
• Meeting transcription M2: captures local mic in parallel with system audio. Segments tagged local/remote, interleaved on a shared timeline.
  • Silence trim: leading/trailing silence is clipped before transcription so starting a recording before anyone joins doesn't pollute the transcript.
  • Fix: Whisper pinned to language=en, temperature=0 — no more random Japanese hallucinations on silent audio.
  • Visual: distinct red+pulsing menu bar icon during meeting recording. Audible cue when Fn-dictation is suppressed because a meeting is active.
  • Fix: hotkey recorder accepts multi-modifier combos (Ctrl+Opt+M, etc); existing global hotkey is muted while configuring a new one.
  • Fix: stale meeting session bug — could not start a new session after completing/failing one.

item.title: Vox 0.3.2
item.description:
• Fix: Transcription no longer hangs indefinitely when OpenAI stalls. Added a 20s request timeout so failures surface and the menu icon resets.
  • Feature: Spoken "slash" now becomes "/" in command mode. "slash help" → "/help" for Claude Code / Slack / Discord slash commands. "cd slash usr slash local" → "cd /usr/local".

item.title: Vox 0.3.1
item.description: • Fix: Smart Cleanup no longer responds with "Sure, please provide the text…" on short dictations. gpt-4o-mini was treating brief snippets as chat requests; tightened the system prompt and added a short-input bypass (under 15 chars skips the LLM entirely).

item.title: Vox 0.3.0
item.description:
• Smart Cleanup (prose mode) — opt-in LLM polish via gpt-4o-mini removes false starts, fillers, and self-corrections. Settings → Mode → Smart cleanup. Trigger phrases also work: "scratch that" / "delete that" wipes the preceding clause; "new paragraph" inserts \n\n; "new line" inserts \n.
  • Tri-state mode override — Settings → Mode → Auto / Always prose / Always command. Mode-toggle hotkey cycles all three. Lets you force command mode in non-terminal apps (e.g. dictating shell commands into a journal).
  • Arrow + modifier suffix keys — say "control left", "option right", "command shift right" at end of dictation. Works for in-app shortcuts. (Mission Control space-switching needs physical keys — synthetic events filtered by macOS.)
  • Hallucination guard — gpt-4o-mini-transcribe sometimes loops on short or noisy audio (a 3-second clip can produce thousands of repeated chars). Vox now suppresses runaway STT output instead of pasting it.
  • Fix: "cd dot dot" now produces "cd .." (was "cd ." — one dot lost). Same fix preserves "./scripts/build-app.sh" without the stray space.
  • Fix: dictionary entries match repeated occurrences of a word in one sentence, including when punctuation is attached ("Andie, … Andie." now both replace).
  • Fix: "control C" produces real Ctrl+C even when Whisper encodes the spoken phrase as the literal "^C" symbol.

Reminder: macOS TCC keys permission grants on the bundle's cdhash, which changes on every ad-hoc-signed release. After updating, re-grant Microphone, Input Monitoring, and Accessibility in System Settings → Privacy & Security.

item.title: Vox 0.2.1
item.description:
• In-app updates via Sparkle (Check for Updates… in the menu).
  • macOS 26 hotkey recorder + monitor stability fixes.
  • Single-modifier hotkey support (bare ⌘ / ⌃ / ⌥ / ⇧).
  • Menu-bar icon redesign with mode-aware colors.
